## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: max_resolution_attempts key is renamed to max_cycles in all code paths that read or write it — no remaining references to the old key in production code (tests validate the rename is complete in validate-config.sh)

## Overview
Add two tests to tests/scripts/test-validate-config.sh:

1. test_review_max_cycles_valid_key: a config containing review.max_cycles=4 must exit 0 (validate-config.sh accepts it as a known key)
2. test_review_max_resolution_attempts_rejected: a config containing review.max_resolution_attempts=5 must exit 1 (validate-config.sh flags it as unknown — migration completed)

These tests FAIL RED before T4 (validate-config.sh KNOWN_SCALAR_KEYS rename):
- test_review_max_cycles_valid_key fails because review.max_cycles is not yet in KNOWN_SCALAR_KEYS (exit 1 instead of 0)
- test_review_max_resolution_attempts_rejected passes accidentally before T4 (old key is in KNOWN_SCALAR_KEYS, so it doesn't trigger unknown-key check) → this test goes RED (unexpected state). Actually this test PASSES before T4 because old key IS accepted — it would go RED only if we expect it to be rejected. Post-T4 the old key is removed from KNOWN_SCALAR_KEYS so it gets rejected → test passes GREEN.

Wait — re-evaluation: test_review_max_resolution_attempts_rejected asserts the OLD key is rejected (exit 1). Before T4, the old key IS in KNOWN_SCALAR_KEYS → validate-config.sh exits 0 → test assertion "exit 1" fails RED. After T4, old key removed → exits 1 → test passes GREEN. ✓ This is a proper RED test.

## Test Approach

### test_review_max_cycles_valid_key
- Given: fixture config containing only review.max_cycles=4
- When: bash validate-config.sh <fixture>
- Then: exit 0, no stderr (key is known and accepted)

### test_review_max_resolution_attempts_rejected
- Given: fixture config containing only review.max_resolution_attempts=5
- When: bash validate-config.sh <fixture>
- Then: exit 1, stderr mentions review.max_resolution_attempts (unknown key)

## Implementation
Follow the pattern from test_ci_workflow_name_valid_key (lines 153-164 of test-validate-config.sh):
```bash
_snapshot_fail
REVIEW_MAX_CYCLES_CONF="$TMPDIR_FIXTURE/review-max-cycles.conf"
cat > "$REVIEW_MAX_CYCLES_CONF" <<'CONF'
review.max_cycles=4
CONF
stderr_out=$(bash "$SCRIPT" "$REVIEW_MAX_CYCLES_CONF" 2>&1 >/dev/null)
rc=$?
assert_eq "test_review_max_cycles_valid_key exit" "0" "$rc"
assert_pass_if_clean "test_review_max_cycles_valid_key"

_snapshot_fail
REVIEW_OLD_KEY_CONF="$TMPDIR_FIXTURE/review-old-key.conf"
cat > "$REVIEW_OLD_KEY_CONF" <<'CONF'
review.max_resolution_attempts=5
CONF
stderr_out=$(bash "$SCRIPT" "$REVIEW_OLD_KEY_CONF" 2>&1 >/dev/null)
rc=$?
assert_eq "test_review_max_resolution_attempts_rejected exit" "1" "$rc"
assert_contains "test_review_max_resolution_attempts_rejected stderr" "review.max_resolution_attempts" "$stderr_out"
assert_pass_if_clean "test_review_max_resolution_attempts_rejected"
```

## .test-index requirement
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_review_max_cycles_valid_key] for plugins/dso/scripts/validate-config.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_review_max_cycles_valid_key\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] test_review_max_cycles_valid_key exists in test-validate-config.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_review_max_cycles_valid_key' tests/scripts/test-validate-config.sh
- [ ] test_review_max_resolution_attempts_rejected exists in test-validate-config.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_review_max_resolution_attempts_rejected' tests/scripts/test-validate-config.sh
- [ ] .test-index has RED marker for validate-config.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_review_max_cycles_valid_key\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
